finding.claim: test_apt_installs_jq_but_not_chromium only reads the continuation lines after `apt-get install`, so chromium put back on the install line itself (`--no-install-recommends chromium \`) passes the test. r1 fails_when says chromium is still installed.

fixes.change: test_apt_installs_jq_but_not_chromium now joins continuation lines and reads every apt-get install argument, so chromium on the install line itself fails the test; both mutations (on its own line, and after --no-install-recommends) fail.
